reason: The README presents a DeepSeek Harness plugin whose primary purpose is orchestrating AI video and motion-comic creation, including asset generation, editing, rendering, and distribution workflows.

summaries.zh: 鲸影是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 视频与漫剧制作插件，提供从故事和分镜规划到图像、视频生成及成片导出的多阶段工作流。
summaries.en: Whale is a DeepSeek Harness plugin for AI video and motion-comic production, covering multi-stage planning, image and video generation, editing, rendering, and export.

capabilities: Generates images and videos through configured external providers
Orchestrates multi-stage media production workflows with retries and quota routing
Stores provider credentials in a local vault
Renders video with ffmpeg and exports JianYing drafts
Generates voiceover using local operating-system speech tools
